question:
DRAG DROP -
All logins to a Cisco Nexus 9000 Series Switch must pass through the TACACS+ server at IP address 192.168.10.10. The configuration must meet these requirements: the TACACS+ server must be used for SSH and Telnet; the TACACS+ server key must be Cisco123!; management VRF must be used for connectivity; and the deployment must fail back to local credentials if the TACACS+ server fails to respond within 30 seconds. Drag and drop the code snippets from the right onto the blanks in the code on the left to complete the configuration. Not all code snippets are used.
theory: Meeting all four stated requirements needs three pieces: tacacs-server host ... key Cisco123! timeout 30 sets both the shared secret and the specific 30-second response window used for the 'fail back within 30 seconds' requirement; use-vrf management under the server group scopes TACACS+ traffic to the out-of-band management VRF for connectivity; and aaa authentication login default group tacacs+ local applies to the 'default' method list (covering both SSH and Telnet, unlike a console-scoped policy) and falls back to local credentials only if the TACACS+ group is unreachable. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 18 - AAA NX-OS Configuration examples)
